items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Hamp was always readin’ the Bible, you know.

ctx.x: Was there any memory in that house with your contact with those musicians that touched you really deeply?

Oh, no question! The whole thing was pregnant with elixirs. I mean, those guys ­ they played at the Handy Theater - that stuff’s all gone. My houses where I lived, all that stuff is torn down now. It’s like FedEx or something was going. Anyway, yeah. What it was was it was like deities walking the earth, is what was going on.
